overall_reason: A text page that reads fully with scripts off, wraps long tokens and code inside the screen at 375, and loads 502 KiB; only six font faces that block text while loading remain.

score.reason: T-NO-SCRIPT (13,516 of 13,516 characters), T-WIDTHS (15 long tokens stay inside their boxes at 375, document within the viewport), T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB (502 KiB, LCP 260 ms) and T-HOSTILE-CONTENT pass; what keeps it from 10 is six font-display: block faces (ROB-017).

findings.title: Loading never moves what the visitor is reading
findings.where: Font faces in the stylesheet, all widths
findings.evidence: css.font_face: 15 faces, font_display swap 7, block 6, not set 2; metric_overrides 2.
findings.before: Six faces hide their text until the font file arrives.
findings.after: Set font-display: swap on the block faces and add metric overrides to the fallback, as two faces already do.
findings.why: On a slow line the guidelines are invisible for up to three seconds while the font loads.
